novelty_flags.label: Theorem 6
novelty_flags.one_line: The asserted fixed-support composite-null mixture is not defined anywhere: “with slack” and “uses a mixture” name neither perturbations nor a construction route from the displayed primitives.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 6
soundness_flags.one_line: “the stated fixed-support perturbation construction with slack” is an undefined condition, so the lower-bound theorem does not specify the subexperiment or the class-constant regime over which it quantifies.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 4; Theorems 5–6 upper bounds
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The boundary-uniform endpoint Hessian modulus and quadratic response remainder are open rather than assumed facts.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The simultaneous upper band and matching upper separation bound are claimed only conditional on an affirmative resolution of Open-ended Question 4; the structural frontiers and lower bound are not so conditioned.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Proposition 7
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The finite certificate is conditional on a validated outward-rounded range oracle for the specified numerical representation.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The reported rational chord certificate is claimed only given such an oracle, not for arbitrary floating-point Monge–Ampère output.
